harbor.description: a small working fishing harbor at dusk: weathered wooden pier, moored fishing boats, stacked lobster crates and coiled ropes, warm sodium lamps glowing against a deep blue evening sky, calm dark water

greenhouse.description: the interior of a large Victorian glass greenhouse in bright late-morning sun: white painted iron frames, tall palms and ferns, terracotta pots on wooden benches, a gravel path, dappled sunlight
